There’s only one name when it comes to bodyweight suspension trainers, right? 🤔 

WRONG! The Human Trainer has entered the chat! 💬 

Whether you’re new to working out or a seasoned veteran, the Human Trainer offers simplicity, versatility, and portability in a very cost effective package. 

It travels with ease and mounts just about anywhere: a tree, a doorframe, a pull-up bar, a beam, giving you immediate access to hundreds of bodyweight exercises. No machines, no commute, just you vs. gravity. 

What sets it apart?!

✅ Dual anchor system - nothing converging to chafe your arms. Freedom of movement means cleaner, more stable exercises. 

✅ Built-in door anchor - rubber wedges built into the straps mean hanging from your doorframe happens in seconds!

✅ 5 D-rings - Zero wasted time adjusting the handle height, and even handles every time. This is a huge time (and headache) saver! Micro-adjustments on the cams is still available!

✅ 500lb capacity per strap - As long as your anchor point is strong, these straps aren’t going anywhere! Unless you’re Ronnie Coleman deadlifting 800lb standing in the straps, whatever you can dream up is safe on these.

✅ Real rubber handles - quality handles with built-in foot cradles! No crappy foams that are squishy and lack durability.

Add other attachments that easily clip into the rings and you’ve got infinite variation of exercises at home and on the go! 

Check out the Human Trainer and more at Bells of Steel 🚀 
Link in bio 🔗

Brand new in crate!
NNI Fitness commercial grade multi-purpose home Smith Machine for a complete workout which includes a Power Rack, Functional Trainer, Smith Machine, Chin Up Station, Dip Station, Core Trainer, and Suspension Trainer.

Commercial Home Gym Smith Machine with 16 adjustable heights. 1:1 pull ratio. This gym set is specific to ONLY what we sell on this website. 

2* 200 weight stack connected to the cables and picture attachment comes with all machines to include a leg press plate!
Strong commercial style machine with options for many exercises. Counterbalanced smith machine with sealed bearing pulleys.
Size: 79"W x 49"D x 90"H. 990 lbs limit for the racks, 770 lbs limit for the bar.
Note: does not come with bench nor any free weights. 1 yr warranty.

Product description
This is a great product for a complete workout. Commercial grade multi-functional all-in-one smith machine with twin pulley cables 1:1 ratio with 16 adjustments for any height cable workouts: arms, chest, back, legs, lat pulldowns, power cage for bench press, squats, fixing point for bands. 5-way grip pull up bar, J hooks for dips, leg exercises using the cables, 2*200 lb stack weights (move in 5 kg increments) for the cable’s exercises. Includes a 2x safety spotter bar to protect while working out alone. The weight limit for racks is 990 lbs and 770 lbs for the bar. 

1. Power Rack
Perform squats, bench presses, overhead presses, deadlifts, and more. The Power Rack component includes commercial-grade J-Hooks and Safeties which can be adjusted to any height position you need. Removable rubber barbell protector sleeves protect your barbell knurling and extend the life of your barbell.

2. Functional Trainer
The Functional Trainer component includes 2 x 200 lbs weight stacks with Commercial Grade aircraft cable, quick and easy pop-pin adjustments, and compatible with a huge range of attachments for almost any functional training exercise.

3. Smith Machine
The Smith Machine component is angled for natural body movement to provide a STRONG and SAFE workout. Re-rack your Smith Bar with ease into any height position you need. Fitted with safe lock and release mechanisms as well as a safety catch allowing you to max out your training without the need for a spotter

4. Chin Up Station
Ergonomically designed Multi-Grip Chin Up and Pull Up station with a massive 770 lbs weight rating. Grip positions include wide-grip, close grip, underhand, overhand and a variety of other varied movements

5.  Dip Station
Different grip positions target different upper body muscle groups. The Multi-Grip Dip Handle attachments provide different options for you to choose from. Adjustable height on the power rack gives added flexibility of using weight belts or resistance bands to augment your workout.

6. Core Trainer
Includes an attached landmine station that is suited for all types of rotational torso training and allows for a wide range of upper body training when using an optional barbell (Not included).

7. Suspension Trainer
This commercial smith machine has a suspension trainer ring that is compatible with packages sold separately from TRX® and others.

PRICE DOES NOT INCLUDE SHIPPING.
